user.title: Garage
user.description: Enter your self-hosted Garage server address and the vehicle API token from the web UI's **Vehicle detail → OBD & GPS** page.

sensors.title: Choose sensors to forward
sensors.description: Pick the HA entities to send to Garage. All fields are optional — leave blank and configure later from options.

data.entity_location: Location (device_tracker) — one entity that already carries both latitude and longitude

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Garage
reauth_confirm.description: The API token is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Garage server.

init.title: Choose sensors to forward
init.description: Only non-location changes (e.g. RPM, speed, fuel, odometer) trigger a send; the latest location at that moment is included too. All fields are optional — leave one blank to skip it.

data.entity_location: Location (device_tracker) — one entity that already carries both latitude and longitude
